name: nginx-spa
shape: browser app built by Vite, served by nginx

platform.name: Vercel
platform.why: the root vercel.json sets outputDirectory excalidraw-app/build, headers and redirects, and excalidraw-app's build:app script reads VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA; the Dockerfile (nginx) is the self-hosting image pushed to Docker Hub by .github/workflows/publish-docker.yml

processes.note: Vite builds excalidraw-app into excalidraw-app/build, which nginx serves (on Vercel the same folder is served as static output); collaboration, sharing and the library talk to backends outside this repository by VITE_APP_* URLs
the Docusaurus developer docs, built to dev-docs/build and deployed as its own Vercel project from master

notBreaks.why: browser debug helper: window.setInterval in the editor
Emscripten-generated WASM glue for font subsetting, run in the browser or a web worker
a Node experiment built by scripts/build-node.js that renders a sample scene to test.png on a developer machine; no process serves it
build step (excalidraw-app build:version) that writes version.json into the build output
build script that writes generated WASM bindings into the source tree
release tool that rewrites package.json versions before npm publish
esbuild plugin that writes temporary font files during the package build
socket.io-client in the browser connecting to the external collaboration server; the long-lived connection is not on this site's server

notes: Read the Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml (a dev setup), the root, dev-docs and examples vercel.json files, firebase-project/, the Docker and other workflows, package.json scripts and .env.production (names only). Everything in the repository is browser code, build tooling or docs: no server code exists, so there are no breaks. Firestore and Firebase Storage are used straight from the browser (excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts) and already live on Google; the collaboration websocket server, the share backend and the AI backend are separate services referenced by URL, not in this repository. The two examples under examples/ are demos with their own vercel.json and are left out of processes; dev-docs is listed because it is a real deployed site.
